observing.text_en: Terance Mann makes only 27% of pull-up threes (13/49), vs 40% on catch-and-shoot
observing.basis_zh: 根據 49 次運球急停三分（2025-26 例行賽）
observing.basis_en: Based on 49 pull-up threes (2025-26 regular season)

observing.subject: Duncan Robinson
observing.text_zh: Duncan Robinson 一被貼身（2 呎內）防守，命中率掉到 34%（前鋒平均 50%）
observing.text_en: Duncan Robinson drops to 34% with a defender within 2 ft (forwards average 50%)
observing.basis_zh: 根據 35 次被貼身防守的出手（2025-26 例行賽）
observing.basis_en: Based on 35 tightly contested shots (2025-26 regular season)

observing.subject: Egor Dëmin
observing.text_zh: Egor Dëmin 底角三分 24/52（46%），弧頂一帶只有 37%
observing.text_en: Egor Dëmin hits 46% from the corners (24/52) but 37% above the break
observing.basis_zh: 根據 52 次底角三分（2025-26 例行賽）
observing.basis_en: Based on 52 corner threes (2025-26 regular season)
